description: This file implements the 'Create' feature for articles, including data validation, command handling, and the logic for creating a new article in the database, associated tags, and author.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Represents the data needed to create an article, including optional fields for title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validates the ArticleData fields to ensure they are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Encapsulates the create article request with ArticleData as input, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command, specifically ensuring the Article data is provided and valid.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the create article command by constructing the article, handling tags, and saving to the database.

methods.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator()
methods.description: Constructor that sets validation rules for ArticleData fields.

methods.name: Create.CommandValidator()
methods.description: Constructor that applies validation rules to the command, ensuring Article data is validated.

methods.name: Create.Handler.Handle()
methods.description: Executes the logic to create and save a new article, associate tags, and return the article envelope.
